title: Junior Resident (Adhoc Basis)
organization: Lok Nayak Hospital, Government of NCT of Delhi
salary_range: Pay Matrix Level-10 (Basic Pay Rs. 56,100/- per month)
age_limit: Not exceeding 30 years as on 01.11.2026 (relaxations as per rules)
summary: Lok Nayak Hospital, New Delhi has invited applications to fill 32 vacancies for Junior Resident (Non-PG) on an adhoc basis for an initial period of 89 days. Candidates must submit hard copies of their applications to the E-I Branch by November 30, 2026. Interviews are scheduled for December 15, 2026.
eligibility_bullets: MBBS degree from a recognized University/Institute or equivalent qualification.
Internship must be completed after 30.11.2024 and before 30.11.2026.
Age not exceeding 30 years as on 01.11.2026 with applicable relaxations.
how_to_apply_steps: Download the application format from the official notification.

Fill in all required details and attach self-attested copies of required certificates including birth certificate, MBBS degree/mark sheets, valid DMC registration, internship completion certificate, and category certificate.
Submit the physical hard copy application at the E-I Branch, MRD Block, 1st Floor, Lok Nayak Hospital, New Delhi-110002 before the deadline. Soft copies will not be accepted.
